lessons: Review found plan defects in the section 20 registry. The ticket copies that registry verbatim and Scope out forbids changing it, so no implementer can satisfy review without a plan edit.
retro-drain-invoker's fence omits squatch/__main__.py, where Drain is built. A default-off hook with no production binding breaks section 19's rule that retro is wired from the drain entrypoint.

Section 20 says the retro report goes through the ordinary artifacts/stages writer. Sections 14/19 require tickets/retro/<seq>.md via the ticket-plane lane in MAIN under the writer lock, and retro is a reserved stem.

The retro trigger must follow section 19: an unforced check of N/M/S thresholds each iteration, a forced run at quiescence and before phase-exit dispatch only if a merge landed since the last report, and a designed failure path.
retro-box-activation's merge signal is 'stated in section 19' but its ticket cites section 20 only. Section 20 must carry the signal's event kind, key, provenance fields and merge.py emit point.

phase5-continue: retro.py and test_retro.py are merged by then, so scorecard-reporting must embed them or name them as measured on-demand Context. Only scorecard.py, test_scorecard.py and test_seeded_phase5_02.py are sibling-new.
